verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an incident-management SaaS, but nothing in the evidence describes a self-hosted or on-prem deployment of incident.io. The material points to a vendor-hosted service: the API is hosted at api.incident.io, and the MCP server is remote. Bring-your-own Twilio numbers and the Terraform provider are adjacent configuration features, not self-hosting of the core product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
